observed_failure: Numeric value mismatch for object Bodies: 'Sum: 6.06775878802135438e+00' vs 'Sum: 3.19574154384071392e+01'
finding: The fused force/integration kernel reads all old positions and overwrites updated positions in the same global arrays. There is no grid-wide ordering between readers and writers; any shared-memory barriers only order one block. A block that finishes early can overwrite positions another block is still reading.
interpretation: Pre-existing CUDA correctness defect exposed by n=1031. Exclusive execution and internal finite-value validation succeed, but independent numerical validation fails. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exclusive numerical failure; no new program execution.
